spec.claim_summary: Enter on an 8-day and 21-day EMA cross and exit if price crosses the 21-day EMA or after 6 days.

claimed.other: much more profit than loss. 6 positions were taken in 10 months (304 days), an average of one every 51 days.

assumptions: Asset is BTCUSDT inferred from page context; claim text names no asset.
Timeframe is 1d inferred from page chart timeframe and day-based EMA lengths; claim text does not state a timeframe.

NOT EXPRESSIBLE: claim describes direction-agnostic EMA crosses in both directions with side-dependent stop/exit; schema allows only long or short so spec tests the long side (8 crosses above 21) as closest testable core and omits short-side trades.
Entry direction narrowed to crosses_above for the long side; generic 'cross' cannot be encoded as either-direction cross.
Entries evaluated on bar closes with fill at next bar open per engine rules.
Stop 'just the other side of the 21 day EMA and adjust daily' approximated as exit on daily close crossing the 21 EMA; intrabar touch and exact stop distance not modeled.
No profit target stated so none used; exit is failure cross or 6-bar time limit.

evidence.quote: The 8 day and 21 day EMAs cross.
If price crosses the 21 day EMA , your setup has failed.
then monitor for a maximum of 6 days.

audit_majors: direction: Claim states generic cross - 'The 8 day and 21 day EMAs cross' with stop 'just the other side of the 21 day EMA' and failure 'If price crosses the 21 day EMA' - implying both bullish and bearish setups. Spec tests only long side (direction long, 8 crosses_above 21, exit crosses_below) and omits short-side trades, which changes the set of trades tested.
